column1: # WHO IS AVAILABLE -- append-only, and current availability is DERIVED.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: it was the second item on the demand-side table in
# dlwork/tooling_plan.md and it lived NOWHERE. Every time an expedition was
# outfitted the DM re-derived it out of prose -- "Hask is on the wool road and
# Rowe went with Halm, so eight are available" -- and a re-derivation is a place
# an error gets in. It is also the fact that decides who may be rolled for.
# One row per CHANGE, not per person per day. The current status of a character
# is the latest row for that name; anyone with no row at all is `present`.
#   present    with the party, fit, may be rolled for
#   away       elsewhere on campaign business -- NOT available and NOT a casualty
#   invalid    present but out of action under a rule (DMG p.82's week, illness)
# `until_day` is a FORECAST and may be blank. It does not close the row -- a
# return is its own `present` row, logged when it happens. A forecast that
# closes itself is how "Rowe stays until his foot heals" outlived the fact.
# This file covers the NINE CHARACTERS in characters.tsv only. NPC whereabouts
# are a different question and belong with the entity work in phase 4.

SOUTH WITH THE CART on the morning of the 99th -- one cart, one mule, 421 lb of salvage plus the pans, the sheave block and the kettle. Wethersby by evening, MARKET ON THE 100th. He is to ask Wend about the kettle BEFORE selling it and hold it aside if she says so, and to ask Coll for Sarn to keep the record. *** DAVE STOOD SURETY FOR THIS MAN PERSONALLY with his purse and his name, and has just handed him a cart of goods and the takings. *** He cannot read or reckon (d6=2, day 98), which is why the clerk matters and not a formality

SOUTH WITH HASK, and she is his own pick out of a pool of three (d6=1). npcs.md: one of the four off the road, 'sharp, says little, means it', the first of them to accept giving up the road, and SHE DECIDES FOR HASK WHEN HE CAN'T. He did not take a bodyguard, he took his judgment. Carries her one cure light wounds and two LIGHT spells that no cleric in this party has cast in ninety-nine days

RODE SOUTH TO WETHERSBY the afternoon of the 99th, straight out of the crag with the library's salvage -- ten books, three scrolls and the twenty feet of copper wire, 131 lb on the third horse. Twenty-two miles, 20 of it made road, half a day's ride. *** TO TOLLER, who is a BOOK AND CURIO DEALER and already holds the four books and the area 6 papers on open terms. *** Back on the 100th, which is a MARKET DAY -- Hask and Dellie are there already. The 101st is the watercourse and the carts go the long way round from first light.
